epoch_selection: nearest actual RAWX epoch within 0.05 s of each integer relative second; no retiming
code_variance_convention: q = elevation_multiplier * CNO_multiplier; sigma = sqrt(q), as author GraphGNSSLib cofactorMatrixCal_WLS and factor whitening
doppler_graph_std_source: GraphGNSSLib d861802 psr_doppler_fusion.h var=0.6, used as residual denominator
atmosphere: RTKLIB broadcast Klobuchar + Saastamoinen; frequency-scaled ionosphere; broadcast TGD; satellite clock and relativity; one Earth-rotation correction
constellation_clock_model: one independent receiver code clock in metres for each actually observed system at an epoch
initial_position_source: raw-code RTKLIB coarse seed followed by un-rejected raw WLS; never provider navigation or trace
